# Di

[Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society)

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011)</sub>
- **Origin:** Orchard Slope  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Di is a very pretty girl who inherits her mother's black hair, black eyes, and rosy cheeks, along with her father's merry expression. Her overall appearance is noted for its vibrant snap and color.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043)_

## Personality

Di is characterized by her goodness and intelligence. These qualities are considered her defining strengths, valued even above physical appearance.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040)_

- good and smart  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040)</sub>

## History

Di, also known as Diana Barry, became [Anne](../character/anne.md) Shirley's sworn best friend after they met at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope). During a party at her house, [Anne](../character/anne.md) broke her ankle, leaving Di and other peers to visit her during her seven-week recovery. Later, Di was unable to join [Anne](../character/anne.md) in Miss Stacy's advanced class preparing for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination because she was not taking the exam. She subsequently joined [Anne](../character/anne.md) in collecting subscriptions along the [Newbridge](../codex/places.md#newbridge) road for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society), and she later helped [Anne](../character/anne.md) handle an accidental dye mishap and prepare a successful dinner when a famous author visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P1](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P2](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P3](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P4](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P7](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008), +100 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--di.md)

- Friend of — close friends and schoolmates  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P3](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0003), +5 more</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--di.md)

Di and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) became best friends after meeting in the [Barry](../character/barry.md) garden at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), where they solemnly vowed to be devoted companions forever. Throughout their girlhood, Di supports [Anne](../character/anne.md) through various misadventures, such as visiting her faithfully while [Anne](../character/anne.md) heals from a broken ankle and coming to her rescue with a roast chicken when [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally dyes her nose red before hosting an important guest. Although a slight distance arises when [Anne](../character/anne.md) joins an advanced class for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination that Di does not take, they remain close chums who work together on local efforts like collecting subscriptions for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society).

- Friend of — close friends and chums  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P0](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0000), +3 more</sub>

### [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/di--fred-wright.md)

Di is romantically involved with [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), who begins actively courting her.
